channel.title: Help. I posted my SCP but it says access denied.
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "Help. I posted my SCP but it says access denied." - I posted an SCP in the 5129 spot but it still says access denied.

item.title: Re: Help. I posted my SCP but it says access denied.
item.content:encoded:
Alright, so what you have to do is go to the series page in question, and scroll to the bottom of the page. There, you should be able to see a series of red buttons; the furthermost one on the left being the word "edit". Click that, and scroll through the edit box to the slot № that you applied your article to ( * [[[SCP-5129]]] - [ACCESS DENIED] ).

Delete the text that says "[ACCESS DENIED]" and add whatever title you want. Do not change anything else on the page. Once finished, you can click save, and that's it. For the .aic elements like Secretary_Helen or CROM, it may take around 5 minutes to update, but Wikidot will do so instantly.

item.title: Help. I posted my SCP but it says access denied.
item.content:encoded: I posted an SCP in series 6, more specifically SCP-5129. If you click on it, you will notice that my SCP is in fact there. If it says "access denied", (which it does) it means that its empty and no one has written on it, but I have. Im really confused on whats going on and I'm going through a lot of trouble to just get the SCP I worked on for two weeks straight "posted" even though it already has been. I am a site memeber and I could use any help. Im desperate. Thank you.
